articles.title: Operation Sadbhavana: Army Continues Humanitarian Aid in Flood-Hit Northeast
articles.title_hi: ऑपरेशन Sadbhavana: सेना बाढ़ प्रभावित पूर्वोत्तर में मानवीय सहायता जारी
articles.summary: The Indian Army's Operation Sadbhavana deployed medical and engineering columns in Assam and Meghalaya as monsoon floods displaced thousands across the Brahmaputra basin.
articles.summary_hi: Indian Army के Operation Sadbhavana ने Assam और Meghalaya में medical और engineering columns तैनात किए, क्योंकि monsoon floods ने Brahmaputra basin में हजारों को विस्थापित किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Indian Army continued Operation Sadbhavana in flood-affected districts of Assam and Meghalaya. Columns provided medical camps, bridge repair, and relief material distribution alongside NDRF and state agencies.

The CWC-IMD AI flood warning system (launched 1 August) provided 5-day alerts. Brahmaputra river levels crossed danger marks at Dibrugarh, Tezpur, and Guwahati.

For IB ACIO: Operation Sadbhavana, Indian Army, Northeast floods, works with NDRF.
articles.content_hi:
Operation Sadbhavana: Indian Army, Assam-Meghalaya floods। NDRF के साथ। CWC-IMD AI EWS support।

IB ACIO: Sadbhavana — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: Operation Sadbhavana किसकी मानवीय पहल है?
articles.explanation: Operation Sadbhavana is the Indian Army's civic action and humanitarian aid programme.
articles.explanation_hi: Operation Sadbhavana Indian Army की civic action और मानवीय सहायता कार्यक्रम है।

articles.title: India Hosts BIMSTEC Counter-Terrorism Exercise 'BIMSTEC Thunder 2026'
articles.title_hi: भारत ने BIMSTEC आतंकवाद-रोधी अभ्यास 'BIMSTEC Thunder 2026' की मेजबानी की
articles.summary: India hosted the first BIMSTEC counter-terrorism field training exercise in Pune, with participation from Bangladesh, Bhutan, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Thailand.
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने Pune में पहला BIMSTEC counter-terrorism field training exercise की मेजबानी की, जिसमें Bangladesh, Bhutan, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka और Thailand ने भाग लिया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India hosted 'BIMSTEC Thunder 2026', the first counter-terrorism field training exercise under the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) in Pune, Maharashtra.

Participants included NSG and special forces from member states. BIMSTEC has 7 members: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Thailand. Secretariat is in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

For IB ACIO: BIMSTEC — 7 members, HQ Dhaka, Thunder 2026 counter-terror exercise in India.
articles.content_hi:
BIMSTEC Thunder 2026: Pune, counter-terror FTX। BIMSTEC — 7 members, HQ Dhaka। Members: BD, BT, IN, MM, NP, LK, TH।

IB ACIO: BIMSTEC 7 members — याद रखें।

articles.explanation: The BIMSTEC Secretariat is headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
articles.explanation_hi: BIMSTEC सचिवालय ढाका, बांग्लादेश में स्थित है।

articles.title: Rahul Chaudhary Appointed Director General, Narcotics Control Bureau
articles.title_hi: राहुल चौधरी को Narcotics Control Bureau के महानिदेशक नियुक्त
articles.summary: Senior IPS officer Rahul Chaudhary was appointed Director General of the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
articles.summary_hi: वरिष्ठ IPS अधिकारी राहुल चौधरी को गृह मंत्रालय के अधीन Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) का महानिदेशक नियुक्त किया गया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, IPS officer Rahul Chaudhary was appointed Director General of the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), Ministry of Home Affairs. NCB is the nodal agency for drug law enforcement under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.

NCB coordinates with state police, customs, and international agencies like UNODC and INTERPOL on drug trafficking. HQ is in New Delhi.

For IB ACIO: NCB, NDPS Act 1985, MHA, DG Rahul Chaudhary.
articles.content_hi:
NCB: NDPS Act 1985, MHA। DG — Rahul Chaudhary (Aug 2026)। HQ — New Delhi। UNODC, INTERPOL links।

IB ACIO: NCB NDPS 1985 — याद रखें।
articles.question: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) functions under which Act?
articles.question_hi: Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) किस अधिनियम के तहत कार्य करता है?
articles.explanation: NCB is the nodal drug enforcement agency under the NDPS Act, 1985.
articles.explanation_hi: NCB NDPS Act, 1985 के तहत nodal drug enforcement agency है।

articles.title: India Successfully Tests Agni-Prime Missile from APJ Abdul Kalam Island
articles.title_hi: भारत ने APJ Abdul Kalam Island से Agni-Prime मिसाइल का सफल परीक्षण किया
articles.summary: DRDO conducted a successful test of the Agni-Prime (Agni-P) canisterised ballistic missile with a range of 1,000-2,000 km from Odisha's APJ Abdul Kalam Island.
articles.summary_hi: DRDO ने Odisha के APJ Abdul Kalam Island से 1,000-2,000 km रेंज वाली Agni-Prime (Agni-P) canisterised ballistic missile का सफल परीक्षण किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, DRDO successfully tested Agni-Prime (Agni-P), a new generation canisterised nuclear-capable ballistic missile, from APJ Abdul Kalam Island (formerly Wheeler Island), Odisha. Range: 1,000–2,000 km.

Agni-P replaces Agni-I in the arsenal with improved accuracy, mobility, and reduced preparation time. It is road-mobile and canister-launched.

For IB ACIO: Agni-P, DRDO, APJ Abdul Kalam Island, range 1000-2000 km.
articles.content_hi:
Agni-Prime (Agni-P): DRDO test, APJ Abdul Kalam Island (Odisha)। Range — 1,000-2,000 km, canisterised, road-mobile।

IB ACIO: Agni-P — याद रखें।
articles.question: Agni-Prime (Agni-P) missile has an operational range of approximately:
articles.question_hi: Agni-Prime (Agni-P) मिसाइल की operational range लगभग कितनी है?
articles.explanation: Agni-P has a range of 1,000 to 2,000 kilometres.
articles.explanation_hi: Agni-P की range 1,000 से 2,000 किलोमीटर है।

articles.title: India Becomes World's Largest Producer of Milk for Eighth Consecutive Year
articles.title_hi: भारत लगातार आठवें वर्ष विश्व का सबसे बड़ा दूध उत्पादक बना
articles.summary: NDDB data for 2025-26 confirms India as the world's largest milk producer at over 240 million tonnes annually, ahead of the EU and the United States.
articles.summary_hi: 2025-26 के NDDB आंकड़े भारत को वार्षिक 240 million tonnes से अधिक दूध उत्पादन के साथ विश्व का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक पुष्टि करते हैं, EU और USA से आगे।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) reported that India remained the world's largest milk producer for the eighth consecutive year, with output exceeding 240 million tonnes in 2025-26.

The White Revolution, led by Operation Flood (1970–1996) and Dr Verghese Kurien, transformed India from a milk-deficient nation to the global leader. Cooperatives like Amul form the backbone.

For IB ACIO: India #1 milk producer, NDDB, Operation Flood, Dr Verghese Kurien.
articles.content_hi:
India: world's largest milk producer (8th year), 240+ MT। Operation Flood, Dr Verghese Kurien, NDDB, Amul cooperatives।

IB ACIO: White Revolution — याद रखें।
articles.question: India's White Revolution is associated with:
articles.question_hi: भारत का White Revolution किससे संबंधित है?
articles.explanation: Dr Verghese Kurien, the 'Milkman of India', led the White Revolution through Operation Flood.
articles.explanation_hi: डॉ. वर्गीज कुरियन 'भारत के Milkman' Operation Flood के माध्यम से White Revolution के architect थे।

articles.title: Supreme Court Upholds Validity of Section 6A of Citizenship Act in Assam
articles.title_hi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने Assam में Citizenship Act की Section 6A की वैधता बरकरार रखी
articles.summary: A Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court upheld Section 6A of the Citizenship Act, 1955, which applies the Assam Accord cut-off date of 25 March 1971 for citizenship determination.
articles.summary_hi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की Constitution Bench ने Citizenship Act, 1955 की Section 6A की वैधता बरकरार रखी, जो Assam Accord cut-off date 25 March 1971 लागू करती है।
articles.content:
In August 2026, a 5-judge Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court upheld the constitutional validity of Section 6A of the Citizenship Act, 1955, as applicable to Assam. Section 6A implements the Assam Accord (1985) cut-off of 25 March 1971 for detecting illegal immigrants.

The bench addressed petitions challenging the provision's scope. Foreigners Tribunals and NRC processes operate under related statutory frameworks in Assam.

For IB ACIO: Section 6A, Citizenship Act 1955, Assam Accord cut-off 25 March 1971.
articles.content_hi:
Section 6A, Citizenship Act 1955: Assam Accord cut-off — 25 March 1971। SC upheld validity (Aug 2026)।

IB ACIO: Assam Accord 1971 — याद रखें।
articles.question: Under the Assam Accord, the cut-off date for detection of illegal immigrants is:
articles.question_hi: Assam Accord के तहत illegal immigrants की पहचान की cut-off date क्या है?
articles.explanation: The Assam Accord sets 25 March 1971 as the cut-off date for citizenship determination in Assam.
articles.explanation_hi: Assam Accord Assam में citizenship determination हेतु 25 मार्च 1971 को cut-off date निर्धारित करता है।

articles.title: BRICS Summit 2026: India Proposes 'Digital Public Infrastructure' Working Group
articles.title_hi: BRICS Summit 2026: भारत ने 'Digital Public Infrastructure' Working Group प्रस्तावित किया
articles.summary: At the BRICS Summit, India proposed a working group on Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) to share UPI, Aadhaar, and DigiLocker models among member nations.
articles.summary_hi: BRICS Summit में भारत ने Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) पर working group प्रस्तावित किया, जो UPI, Aadhaar और DigiLocker models सदस्य देशों में साझा करेगा।
articles.content:
At the 2026 BRICS Summit, India proposed a Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) working group to export models like UPI, Aadhaar, and DigiLocker to member countries. BRICS members: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, plus expanded members including Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE, and others.

India's G20 presidency had earlier championed DPI as a global public good. NPCI International facilitates UPI expansion abroad.

For IB ACIO: BRICS, India DPI proposal, UPI/Aadhaar/DigiLocker, NPCI.
articles.content_hi:
BRICS 2026: India DPI working group proposal। Models — UPI, Aadhaar, DigiLocker। NPCI International।

IB ACIO: BRICS DPI — याद रखें।

articles.title: India Wins Women's Asia Cup Hockey 2026 Title
articles.title_hi: भारत ने Women's Asia Cup Hockey 2026 खिताब जीता
articles.summary: The Indian women's hockey team defeated China 3-1 in the final to win the Women's Asia Cup 2026 in Rajgir, Bihar, securing qualification for the 2026 World Cup.
articles.summary_hi: Indian women's hockey team ने final में China को 3-1 से हराकर Rajgir, Bihar में Women's Asia Cup 2026 जीता और 2026 World Cup qualification सुरक्षित की।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India won the Women's Asia Cup Hockey 2026 in Rajgir, Bihar, defeating China 3-1 in the final. Captain Savita Punia led the team. The victory secured India's berth in the FIH Hockey Women's World Cup 2026.

Rajgir's Rajgir Hockey Stadium hosted the tournament. India has won the Women's Asia Cup multiple times, reinforcing its dominance in Asian hockey.

For IB ACIO: Women's Asia Cup Hockey 2026 — Rajgir, India beat China, Savita Punia.
articles.content_hi:
Women's Asia Cup Hockey 2026: Rajgir (Bihar)। India beat China 3-1। Captain — Savita Punia। World Cup qualification secured।

IB ACIO: Rajgir hockey — याद रखें।

articles.title: RBI Launches CBDC Retail Pilot Expansion to Five More Cities
articles.title_hi: RBI ने CBDC Retail Pilot को पांच और शहरों में विस्तारित किया
articles.summary: The RBI expanded the digital rupee (e₹) retail pilot to Jaipur, Lucknow, Bhopal, Patna, and Thiruvananthapuram, joining existing pilot cities.
articles.summary_hi: RBI ने digital rupee (e₹) retail pilot को Jaipur, Lucknow, Bhopal, Patna और Thiruvananthapuram में विस्तारित किया, मौजूदा pilot cities के साथ।
articles.content:
In August 2026, RBI expanded the Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) retail pilot (e₹-R) to five new cities. Users can transact via participating bank apps. Delhi Lakshmi Yojana offers optional CBDC wallet disbursement (Rs 1,000 component).

CBDC retail pilot began on 1 December 2022 in Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru, and Bhubaneswar. Wholesale CBDC (e₹-W) pilot runs separately for interbank settlement.

For IB ACIO: CBDC e₹-R, RBI, retail pilot started Dec 2022, expanded 2026.
articles.content_hi:
CBDC retail (e₹-R): RBI pilot expanded Aug 2026। Started Dec 2022 (Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Bhubaneswar)। Delhi Lakshmi Yojana CBDC option।

IB ACIO: CBDC e₹ — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: भारत का CBDC retail pilot (digital rupee) पहली बार कब शुरू हुआ?
articles.explanation: The CBDC retail pilot was launched on 1 December 2022.
articles.explanation_hi: CBDC retail pilot 1 दिसंबर 2022 को शुरू हुआ।

articles.title: PM-KUSUM Component-A Crosses 10 GW Installed Solar Capacity
articles.title_hi: PM-KUSUM Component-A ने 10 GW Installed Solar Capacity पार की
articles.summary: The PM-KUSUM scheme's Component-A (grid-connected solar power plants on barren/fallow land) crossed 10 GW installed capacity, benefiting farmer-producer organisations.
articles.summary_hi: PM-KUSUM scheme के Component-A (barren/fallow land पर grid-connected solar plants) ने 10 GW installed capacity पार की, farmer-producer organisations को लाभ।
articles.content:
In August 2026, PM-KUSUM Component-A crossed 10 GW of installed solar capacity. PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan) has three components: A (renewable power plants), B (standalone pumps), C (grid-connected pumps).

Launched in 2019, the scheme aims to de-dieselise agriculture and provide farmers income from solar power sale. MNRE implements the scheme.

For IB ACIO: PM-KUSUM 2019, Components A/B/C, MNRE, 10 GW milestone Component-A.
articles.content_hi:
PM-KUSUM (2019, MNRE): A — solar plants, B — standalone pumps, C — grid pumps। Component-A — 10 GW milestone (Aug 2026)।

IB ACIO: PM-KUSUM components — याद रखें।
articles.question: PM-KUSUM Component-A involves:
articles.explanation: Component-A covers grid-connected renewable power plants on barren or fallow land.
articles.explanation_hi: Component-A barren/fallow land पर grid-connected renewable power plants को कवर करता है।
